scope: Bounded CURRENT read-model/publication/consumer evidence for Sessions/pane-context and native workspace/pane/window/terminal clients. These are existing types/fields, not future prepared-view interfaces or ownership choices.
evidencePolicy: Current source facts are based on opened declarations plus writer/composition/consumer code. Prior same-HEAD RPC/status/native walks are explicitly labeled. nativeOnlyFacts and selectionLimit fields are evidence-bounded implications/limits, not executed Host/native proof or new owner decisions.

productionComposition.meaning: Actual IPC startup awaits Sessions/pane-context preparation and passes the result into makeAppIPCServer before server.start.
Composition built with app IPC owner; status sink applies SessionStatusAtom, graph directory/datastore/UI publication roots injected.
Actual repository/service/bridge/status/open-ask/agent-line joins; presentation lane applies compact display atom.
Native UI readers use these actual keyed atoms plus current service adapter.
Surface coordinator and UI adapter receive actual composition; teardown clears references then shuts it down.

effectfulReadDistinctions.name: compact PaneContextService.readDisplay/computeDisplay
effectfulReadDistinctions.effect: write transaction expires lines, hides settled records and bumps source revisions before display fold

effectfulReadDistinctions.name: pane.context.get / readDetail
effectfulReadDistinctions.effect: conditional ensureOpen startup settlement/retirement drain, then ordinary SQL read and in-memory detail revision bookkeeping; no mark-read

effectfulReadDistinctions.name: session.query / Sessions summary
effectfulReadDistinctions.effect: can hydrate runtime, load asks, consume viewed/retired input and publish status; actual ask-source bridge may reach service opening

effectfulReadDistinctions.name: pane.message.changes
effectfulReadDistinctions.effect: separate durable reported-position/receipt confirmation and acknowledged event pruning; not the detail read or UI rendering

effectfulReadDistinctions.name: UI markRead / answer / message action
effectfulReadDistinctions.effect: explicit person mutations then refresh; location restrictions differ by action

effectfulReadDistinctions.name: workspace/window/terminal snapshots
effectfulReadDistinctions.effect: immediate current atom/runtime reads; terminal timestamp sampled with Date(); not mutation receipt, native pixels, terminal output or durable event cut
